overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG evaluation through dialogue generation with African American English (AAE) style transfer. The extraction was generally accurate but needed consolidation of redundant items and clarification of what constitutes automatic metrics vs. human evaluation criteria. The paper uses LLMs both for generation (primary NLG task) and evaluation (feature tagging), which is correctly captured.
